text_blocks.snippet: Yes, that's correct. Viral sexually transmitted infections (STIs) like HIV, herpes, human papillomavirus (HPV), and hepatitis, are generally not curable and require ongoing management with medications. While antibiotics can cure STIs caused by bacteria or parasites, viral STIs cannot be eliminated from the body, but antiviral medications can help manage symptoms and reduce the risk of transmission.

list.title: Viral nature:
list.snippet: Viruses integrate themselves into the host's cells, making it difficult for medications to eradicate them completely.

list.title: Treatment goals:
list.snippet: Antiviral medications focus on controlling the virus's replication, reducing the severity and frequency of outbreaks, and minimizing the risk of transmission to others.
